answer: Panel seats and emission require five established seals collected in the current epoch, and each rater may issue only one of those seals per epoch. If any two of the five already co-signed more than three other applicants in the previous two epochs, both seals are void and the applicant waits one epoch. A sable sockpuppet farm cannot buy scale from one rater clique; every lantern seal spends a scarce per-epoch budget, and any jade overlap above that three-applicant threshold is a public ledger check peers recompute before they attest.
